name: Ringwold: The Last Collector
storyline:
Rip packs, work strange machines, chase rare variants, and build the weirdest creature card collection in the universe.
Ringwold: The Last Collector is a relaxing card-collecting adventure set aboard a strange alien collector ship filled with unusual machines, upgrades, and creatures reconstructed from corrupted Earth biology data.

Explore the ship as Ringwold, the last of his kind, earn credits, and discover different ways to expand your collection. Open card packs, interact with specialized machines, unlock upgrades, and build out your Cardex as you search for new creatures and increasingly rare variants.

Each card can appear in different rarities, making every pull another chance to find something unusual, valuable, or difficult to obtain. With multiple ways to collect beyond simply opening packs, Ringwold: The Last Collector is designed for players who enjoy completing collections, chasing rare finds, and steadily building something their own.

Take your time, experiment with the ship’s machines, and see how complete your collection can become.
summary: Ringwold, the last of his kind, is trapped aboard a strange collector ship. Explore the ship, earn credits, use specialized machines, unlock upgrades, and collect creature cards reconstructed from corrupted Earth biology.
